summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a routine Form 6-K notification of equity issuance under its existing block listing for the period 1-29 September 2026. The company issued 103,796 ordinary shares of US$0.50 each under the HSBC International Employee Share Purchase Plan, leaving a balance of 1,599,811 unallotted shares under that plan. Post-issuance issued share capital was 17,141,942,291 ordinary shares; new shares rank pari passu with existing shares. No special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor, price terms, or deal mechanics are present. Watch only for routine dilution from employee share plans.
